sentences.en: I would like to purchase your latest mail order catalogue.
sentences.zh: 我想购买你们最新的目录。

sentences.en: It was a purchase which he could not possibly afford.
sentences.zh: 这是一次他根本负担不起的购买。

sentences.en: The millionaire intended to purchase the masterpiece regardless of cost.
sentences.zh: 这位百万富翁打算不惜一切代价购得这件杰作。

mnemonic: 联想记忆：pur+chase（追逐）→为了得到紧俏的商品而竞相追逐→购买
